scripts.postinstall: node scripts/install-git-hooks.mjs && npm --prefix orchestrator install && npm --prefix operator-s-console install
scripts.review-session:ui: node -e "console.log('Review UI is served by the orchestrator runtime. Open http://127.0.0.1:3312/operator/review-sessions after starting npm run review-session:start:24h or npm run review-session:run:24h.')"
scripts.review-session:run:24h: npm run review-session:start:24h && npm run review-session:workload:24h
scripts.review-session:run:quick: npm run review-session:start -- --profile soak-24h --target-task-count=300 && npm run review-session:workload:quick
scripts.review-session:run:3000: npm run review-session:start -- --profile soak-24h --target-task-count=3000 && npm run review-session:workload:3000
scripts.review-session:run:5000: npm run review-session:start -- --profile soak-24h --target-task-count=5000 && npm run review-session:workload:5000
scripts.review-session:run:auto:3000: npm run review-session:start -- --profile soak-24h --target-task-count=3000 && npm run review-session:workload:auto:3000
scripts.dev: npm run build:operator-ui && npm --prefix orchestrator run dev
scripts.build: npm run build:operator-ui && npm --prefix orchestrator run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix orchestrator run typecheck && npm run typecheck:operator-ui
scripts.test: npm --prefix orchestrator run test:run && npm run test:operator-ui
scripts.docs:site:dev: npm run docs:site:sync && npm run docs:site:check && vitepress dev site
scripts.docs:site:build: npm run docs:site:sync && npm run docs:site:check && vitepress build site
scripts.verify: npm run build && npm run docs:drift && npm run docs:links && npm run test:unit && npm run test:integration && npm run test:operator-ui && npm run typecheck
scripts.verify:main: npm run verify && npm run docs:site:build
